title: 6.3 Where Is It?
unit_outcome: Ask where a familiar place is, understand simple directions, and use familiar transportation and schedule language.
goal: Ask where one familiar place or object is and select a short location answer.
grammar_function: Where is + singular noun? It is + known location phrase.
prerequisite: 4.3 Where Things Are introduced location meanings; 6.1 buildings.
speaking_outcome: Ask three where questions and say three corresponding location answers.
